async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Sample Page' link to navigate to a page that might have a search bar
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sample Page").click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Look for a search bar using accessibility roles
    # Try common roles for search inputs
    search_bar = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="search")
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        search_bar = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search...")
    # Fill the search bar with 'GPT' and submit the search by pressing Enter
    await search_bar.fill("GPT")
    await search_bar.press("Enter")
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Identify search results. Try common roles for result items
    articles = page.get_by_role("article")
    links = page.get_by_role("link")
    listitems = page.get_by_role("listitem")
    # Determine which type has results
    if await articles.count() > 0:
        results = articles
    elif await links.count() > 0:
        results = links
    else:
        results = listitems
    # Click on the third result (index 2 in zero-based indexing)
    await results.nth(2).click()
    # Wait for the page to load after clicking the result
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
